50049823.DESCRIPTION: Inhibition of p53 binding to MDM2 (unknown origin) after 30 mins by SPR analysis
50049823.references_previous: 11. Pace CN, Vajdos F, Fee L, Grimsley G, Gray T. Protein Sci. 1995;4:2411.

original_paragraph.SPR Analysis: First of all, to validate the binding affinity of peptides against MDM2/MDMX, we conducted a reported surface plasmon resonance (SPR)-based competition assay,11 in which (15-29) p53 was immobilized on a CM5 sensor chip for kinetic analysis of a fixed concentration of 50 nM MDM2 or 100 nM MDMX pre-incubated with varying concentrations of PMI derivatives. As we expected, the d-amino acid mutated peptides showed at least an equivalent binding affinity against MDM2/MDMX compared with PMI. (Fig. 1A, 1B).
original_paragraph.Figure 1 caption: Fig. 1. A) B) Quantification of the interactions of 50 nM MDM2 and 100 nM MDMX with varying concentrations of free PMI-0-4 by SPR-based competition assays. Each curve is the mean of 3 independent measurements at 25 °C in 10 mM Heps, 150 mM NaCl, 0.005% surfactant P20, pH 7.4. C) Growth inhibition of U87 cells by free PMI-0-4. D) Growth inhibition of U87 cells by Liposome-PMI-1-5 and Nutlin-3. E) Growth inhibition of U87 and U251 cells by Liposome-PMI-1. The starting points (0 μM) represent a negative control containing empty liposome. The inhibition curves are averages of three independently measurements determined by the standard MTT cell viability assay. F) Comparison of the proteolytic stability of free PMI-0 and PMI-1.

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: 10 mM Heps, 150 mM NaCl, 0.005% surfactant P20, pH 7.4
